VAR __Datas = CALCULATETABLE ( VALUES ( dCalendario[Date] ), REMOVEFILTERS ( fHoraHora[Turno] ), REMOVEFILTERS ( ficha_producao[Trançadeira] ) )
VAR __UmDia = COUNTROWS ( __Datas ) = 1
VAR __FT = ISFILTERED ( fHoraHora[Turno] )
VAR __Turnos =
    FILTER (
        SELECTCOLUMNS (
            CALCULATETABLE ( VALUES ( fHoraHora[Turno] ), REMOVEFILTERS ( dCalendario ) ),
            "@T", VAR __tTx = fHoraHora[Turno] & "" VAR __tP1 = SEARCH ( "1", __tTx, 1, 999 ) VAR __tP2 = SEARCH ( "2", __tTx, 1, 999 ) VAR __tP3 = SEARCH ( "3", __tTx, 1, 999 ) VAR __tPm = MIN ( MIN ( __tP1, __tP2 ), __tP3 ) RETURN IF ( __tPm = 999, BLANK (), IF ( __tPm = __tP1, 1, IF ( __tPm = __tP2, 2, 3 ) ) )
        ),
        NOT ISBLANK ( [@T] )
    )
VAR __FM = ISFILTERED ( ficha_producao[Trançadeira] )
VAR __Maqs = DISTINCT ( SELECTCOLUMNS ( FILTERS ( ficha_producao[Trançadeira] ), "@M", VAR __mqSel = UPPER ( SUBSTITUTE ( SUBSTITUTE ( SUBSTITUTE ( SUBSTITUTE ( ficha_producao[Trançadeira], ".", "" ), "-", "" ), " ", "" ), "_", "" ) ) RETURN IF ( __mqSel IN { "SPIRAL", "TE01", "TE0" }, "SPIRAL", __mqSel ) ) )
VAR __MaqTxt = CONCATENATEX ( FILTER ( __Maqs, [@M] <> "" ), [@M], ", ", [@M], ASC )
VAR __TemSp = "SPIRAL" IN __Maqs
VAR __TemBr = NOT ISEMPTY ( FILTER ( __Maqs, [@M] <> "SPIRAL" ) )
VAR __NomeTr = IF ( NOT __FM || ( __TemSp && __TemBr ), "Trançagem + Espiral", IF ( __TemSp, "Espiral", "Trançagem" ) )
VAR __B =
UNION (
    FILTER (
        SELECTCOLUMNS (
            FILTER ( ALL ( ficha_producao ), NOT ISBLANK ( ficha_producao[data_hora_final_trancadeira] ) ),
            "@E", 3,
            "@Dia", VAR __fS3 = ficha_producao[data_hora_final_trancadeira] - 320 / 1440 RETURN DATE ( YEAR ( __fS3 ), MONTH ( __fS3 ), DAY ( __fS3 ) ),
            "@T", VAR __mS3 = HOUR ( ficha_producao[data_hora_final_trancadeira] ) * 60 + MINUTE ( ficha_producao[data_hora_final_trancadeira] ) RETURN IF ( __mS3 >= 320 && __mS3 < 837, 1, IF ( __mS3 >= 837 && __mS3 < 1340, 2, 3 ) ),
            "@Q", VAR __qS3 = ficha_producao[quantidade_trancagem] RETURN IF ( __qS3 > 2000, BLANK (), __qS3 ),
            "@M", VAR __mqS3 = UPPER ( SUBSTITUTE ( SUBSTITUTE ( SUBSTITUTE ( SUBSTITUTE ( ficha_producao[Trançadeira], ".", "" ), "-", "" ), " ", "" ), "_", "" ) ) RETURN IF ( __mqS3 IN { "SPIRAL", "TE01", "TE0" }, "SPIRAL", __mqS3 )
        ),
        [@Dia] IN __Datas
    ),
    FILTER (
        SELECTCOLUMNS (
            FILTER ( ALL ( ficha_producao ), NOT ISBLANK ( ficha_producao[data_hora_final_extracao] ) ),
            "@E", 8,
            "@Dia", VAR __fS8 = ficha_producao[data_hora_final_extracao] - 320 / 1440 RETURN DATE ( YEAR ( __fS8 ), MONTH ( __fS8 ), DAY ( __fS8 ) ),
            "@T", VAR __mS8 = HOUR ( ficha_producao[data_hora_final_extracao] ) * 60 + MINUTE ( ficha_producao[data_hora_final_extracao] ) RETURN IF ( __mS8 >= 320 && __mS8 < 837, 1, IF ( __mS8 >= 837 && __mS8 < 1340, 2, 3 ) ),
            "@Q", VAR __qS8 = ficha_producao[quantidade_extracao] RETURN IF ( __qS8 > 2000, BLANK (), __qS8 ),
            "@M", VAR __mqS8 = UPPER ( SUBSTITUTE ( SUBSTITUTE ( SUBSTITUTE ( SUBSTITUTE ( ficha_producao[Trançadeira], ".", "" ), "-", "" ), " ", "" ), "_", "" ) ) RETURN IF ( __mqS8 IN { "SPIRAL", "TE01", "TE0" }, "SPIRAL", __mqS8 )
        ),
        [@Dia] IN __Datas
    )
)
VAR __BTr = FILTER ( __B, [@E] = 3 )
VAR __DiasCom = DISTINCT ( SELECTCOLUMNS ( __B, "@Dia", [@Dia] ) )
VAR __DiasProd =
    FILTER (
        __DiasCom,
        VAR __dProd = [@Dia]
        RETURN __UmDia || SUMX ( FILTER ( __BTr, [@Dia] = __dProd ), [@Q] ) >= 3000
    )
VAR __nD = COUNTROWS ( __DiasProd )
VAR __LA = FILTER ( __B, ( NOT __FT || [@T] IN __Turnos ) && ( NOT __FM || [@M] IN __Maqs ) )
VAR __LP = FILTER ( __LA, [@Dia] IN __DiasProd )
VAR __M8 = DIVIDE ( SUMX ( FILTER ( __LP, [@E] = 8 ), [@Q] ), __nD )
RETURN
    __M8
